ds_tacz_compat.configuration.title: TACZ DS Compat Config
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.hideFirstPe: When enabled, dragon arms will not render in first-person while holding TACZ guns.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.hideThirdPe: If true, hide third-person guns on dragons entirely. If false, render the gun floating above the dragon.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunHeightOf: Height offset of the floating gun above the dragon's hitbox top, in blocks.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunFloatSpe: Vertical bobbing speed of the floating gun, in full float cycles per second. Set 0 to stop. Higher = faster.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunBaseScal: Base scale of the floating gun. 1.0 matches the item's original size.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunScaleWit: Scale the floating gun with the dragon's size, matching DragonSurvival's third-person item behavior.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunOffsetSc: Scale the floating gun's positional offsets (left/right, forward/back, height) with the dragon's size.
Left/right offset of the floating gun, in blocks. Positive : left.
Forward/back offset of the floating gun, in blocks. Positive : front.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.aimSmoothin: EMA smoothing time for the gun aim-follow animation, in seconds. Set 0 to instant.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.gunPitchCla: Maximum downward pitch in degrees below horizontal. Prevents the gun aiming at dragon body.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.tracerVisib: Show bullet tracers for dragon players.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.hideRemoteT: Hide bullet tracers from other dragon players, matching original TACZ behavior.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.glidingShoo: Allow dragons to shoot while gliding. When disabled, aiming or reloading exits flight.
ds_tacz_compat.configuration.speedInflue: Multiplier for TACZ's movement-speed influence on dragons. 0 cancels it, 1 keeps vanilla, 2 doubles it.
